sentences.text: Chuanjiesaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaurs that lived during the Middle Jurassic Period.
This animal lived in what is now China.
It lived approximately 168 million years ago during the Callovian stage of the Middle Jurassic in what is now Asia.
Chuanjiesaurus was longer than other eusauropods of its time, reaching 25 meters in length with a very long neck.
Fossils were found in the Chuanjie Formation near the village of Chuanjie in Yunnan Province, China, and the genus is named after this location.
The species is known from 20 articulated vertebrae, nine from the neck, along with scapula, humerus, other limb bones, and rib fragments from at least three individuals.
Holtz estimated the length of Chuanjiesaurus to be 25 meters (82 feet).
Chuanjiesaurus is classified within the family Mamenchisauridae.
The animal was initially considered a cetiosaurid but is now classified as a mamenchisaurid.
